mechanism: FERC preliminary permit site-banking under FPA sec. 4(f) / 16 U.S.C. 798, and the 18 CFR 4.32(e) deficiency-and-acceptance gate that manufactures the priority date

sources.story_title: NEWS TRIGGER. DeepGreen Cook Inlet SPV LLC proposes a 100 MW underwater AI data center off Nikiski powered and cooled by Cook Inlet tides, with as many 350 underwater turbines and 66 'hives' housing AI servers. Source of the 18 June 2026 FERC deficiency letter, the Northwest Branch attribution, AEA CEO Curtis Thayer's statement that AEA had never heard of DeepGreen, and FERC spokesperson Celeste Miller's confirmation that the application is still under review. Quote re-verified against the live page by the mapper, which corrected two misquotes carried by the scout.

CHOKEPOINT layer (Layer 2). Acceptance for filing, rejection and deficiency procedure. Vests the conformance judgment in the Director of the Office of Energy Projects, caps the preliminary-permit cure window at 45 days, and provides that a resubmitted application carries a NEW filing date for purposes of timeliness under 4.36 and competing applications under 4.37.

Layer 3, the asset. Preliminary permits issued for the sole purpose of maintaining priority of application for a license, term not exceeding four years, non-transferable, cancellable by Commission order.
Layer 1, the corridor claim. Contents of a preliminary permit application. Exhibit 1 project description, Exhibit 2 study plan, Exhibit 3 maps enclosing the proposed project boundary.

sources.outlet: FERC notice via Federal Register public inspection (Project No. 15317-000, Littoral Power Systems, Upper Cook Inlet Tidal Energy Project)
sources.story_title: Layer 4, public notice and standing. Carries the verbatim statement that the sole purpose of a preliminary permit is priority to file, that it authorizes no land-disturbing activity or entry onto waters owned by others, and the 60-day intervention and competing-application deadline FERC has prescribed in this corridor. NOTE: this project number belongs to LITTORAL POWER SYSTEMS, a different applicant, and must never be attached to DeepGreen.
Layer 5, the contested/uncontested fork. Delegations to the Director, Office of Energy Projects, including appropriate action on uncontested applications for preliminary permits.
